$comment: Packages the daily dependency-update workflow must not move freely. No range, group or follows: never updated by the workflow. range: moves only inside it. group: members move only when they all land on the same version. follows: never moves on its own; after each update it is set to exactly the version the named package, as installed, depends on. See docs/dependencies.md.
